# Build and lint tools for the "Build and smoke test" workflow, pinned by hash.
#
# Installed by .github/workflows/smoke.yml with:
#     pip install --require-hashes --only-binary :all: -r <this file>
#
# --require-hashes needs every transitive dependency pinned too: cmakelang and
# six are dependencies of cmake-format. --only-binary keeps pip from falling
# back to an sdist, whose setup.py would run during the build.
#
# To regenerate after changing a version, list all hashes of that release:
#     pip download --no-deps -d d <package>==<version> && sha256sum d/*
# or regenerate the whole file with:
#     uv pip compile --generate-hashes
